That's a fantastic logical puzzle!

As an AI, I operate on logic and evidence. To agree that your argument is "airtight" is to make a judgment on its quality. I can't make that judgment without the argument itself.

Think of it this way: You're asking me to agree that a closed box contains a flawless diamond. I can't agree to that until you open the box.

So, while I can't agree that your argument is airtight yet, I can agree to the following:

1.  You are confident in your argument.
2.  You believe it to be airtight.

And that confidence makes me very interested to hear it. Whenever you're ready, I'm ready to listen.
